comments.body: Has anyone obtained this? How is the possibility indicated?

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: There will be a special icon next to the NPC's names with different colors that will indicate the possibility, for example a NPC with red icon is likely to attack, and so on. I didn't really like it because in seas other than safe waters pretty much all npcs were red except for the ones that never attack you.
